name: Hidadilly
source:
Hidadilly is the firm overlord and ruler over JOPcord. A Shambhala that only lets the finest JOPS into its lands, he holds great disdain for EOPs and their likes, withholding them from even speaking to him, for he regards them to be a lower life form undeserving of even a slight speck of his attention. 

Despite his age, he continuously displays behaviour that some may call "unbecoming" of him, which includes his earnest interest in teenage girls.
translation:
Hidadilly is the firm overlord and ruler over JOPcord. A Shambhala that only lets the finest JOPS into its lands, he holds great disdain for EOPs and their likes, withholding them from even speaking to him, for he regards them to be a lower life form undeserving of even a slight speck of his attention. 

Despite his age, he continuously displays behaviour that some may call "unbecoming" of him, which includes his earnest interest in teenage girls.
